# Credtent
> Delaware Public Benefit Corporation. Resources for creatives.

Credtent's free opt-out records your AI-training preferences and sends them to AI companies each quarter; it cannot guarantee every company acts on them.

## For creatives
- [Home](https://credtent.org/)
- [Free opt-out](https://credtent.org/opt-out)
- [Creative Consent](https://credtent.org/creative-consent)
- [Auditing](https://credtent.org/resources/auditing)
- [Opt-out limitations](https://credtent.org/resources/opt-out-limitations)
- [Licensing guide](https://credtent.org/guides/ai-training-data-licensing/)

Corporate licensing, valuation, and the company map: see https://credtent.com/llms.txt
